# Original H247 endpoint ledger

Each row requires `H247[i] / Q80 ≤ wuImprovementLimit true δ s`. Generation 247 reads generation 246 and supplies the last step to h248. The two integer columns are verbatim upper numerators at the actual neighboring checkpoints. `Q80 = 1208925819614629174706176`. The source-only bracket theorem covers every index. The full exact H247 array is absent from the stage-248 JSON history record.

The action column gives only the original zero-based rows whose rightmost write is this cell. The other actions reaching the cell remain competing candidates. The seed and the end of the upper Buchstab clamp are identified at their actual indices.

The printed Wu bounds use the next tabulated argument on the right and antitonicity. Each printed amount lies below the earlier stage-184 entry. These are lower estimates for the true function. The source-only fixed-δ comparison is `1/5000 ≤ H` through 2.9 and `9/350000 ≤ H` at 3 when `0 < δ ≤ 1/10`. For `0 < δ ≤ 1/100` the two new actual bounds are `1/300 < H` through 2.5 and `3/7000 < H` thereafter through 3. The 29 historical comparisons remain open. [Wu 2008, §3 Table 1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0709.3764#page=8)
